account_signals: Account resolved from ticket account_id: ACC-8892
Bulk approval request affects 500 purchase orders
Issue is explained by the documented 200-document batch limit
customer_reply: Thanks for reporting this. The Approve button is disabled because bulk approval supports a maximum of 200 purchase orders per batch by design. Please filter the list and process the approvals in batches of 200 or fewer, for example by supplier or date. This is expected behavior rather than a product defect. We have also recorded your request to support larger batches for product review.
internal_note: Resolved to ACC-8892. KB-4859 confirms bulk approval accepts a maximum of 200 documents per batch and disables Approve above that limit. Classify as a P4 feature request for Product, not a bug; no escalation, TAM notification, duplicate, or clarification needed.
